headline: Recovery rebounds; resume with a short easy run
summary: Sleep improved to 7h 17m, readiness to 80 and Body Battery to 96. Run 30–40 minutes easy at RPE 2–3 if symptom-free; no quality work or make-up distance.

recommendation.title: 30–40 minutes easy at RPE 2–3
details: Use a flat or gently rolling route; stay conversational throughout, roughly 5–6 km without chasing distance.
No intervals, tempo, strides, fast finish or make-up mileage. Stop at 40 minutes.
recommendation.alternative: 20–30 minutes relaxed walking or complete rest if sore, sleepy or unwell.
recommendation.reduce_or_stop: Stop for pain that changes gait, illness, unusual fatigue or dizziness. Seek urgent care for chest pain, fainting or severe breathlessness.

signals.label: Sleep improved
signals.interpretation: Supports a cautious return to easy running; one better night does not erase prior short nights.

signals.label: Recovery replenished
signals.interpretation: Supports short easy work, not an immediate hard session.

signals.label: Recent endurance load
signals.interpretation: Keep today capped to avoid another prolonged session.

caveats: Device measurements and classifications are Garmin data; the recommendation is coaching judgment.
Garmin’s recovery timer concerns another hard effort, not all movement.
Pain, illness, unusual sleepiness, dizziness and medical advice override device scores.
